supersedes: Live bootstrap (no PR yet, r2); Build/gate adapter (no PR yet, r3) is the exact prerequisite.

bs1.host: Controller statfs at every check: APFS local work/use/run parents each >=20 GiB.
bs1.docker: No reliable read-only Docker CLI guest-free counter. docker system df reports usage/reclaimable, not VM free. Separate controller observe-disk invokes fixed pinned JRE /usr/bin/df -P -k / with empty --config and no mounts/network; removes and confirms absence. Its raw-output hash and parsed >=20 GiB are bound to the approval window, max 1800s from observation, not operator-entered and not refreshed.
bs1.precondition: Accepted inspection must establish that the container root backing filesystem is the relevant Docker disk, with no per-container quota hiding the relationship. Unknown mapping refuses attended procedure.

excluded: Mac build/gate and ledger results that rehearsal itself evidences

bs3: Repeatable preflight and shared launch checks are read-only, create no probe files/containers, use no secrets, consume no approval. Fixed public codes only, including run/rehearse before admission. Success is preflight-ready-write-probe-pending: actual O_EXCL/write/F_FULLFSYNC/readback is necessarily deferred until separately authorized launch.
bs4: local_images and observation use fixed binary --config <owner-only empty directory> --host <reviewed local endpoint>. configure creates it exclusively beforehand; preflight never creates it.
bs5: OPERATOR-PROCEDURE.txt gives exact physical-line commands to generate config, controller disk evidence, intent, qualification and candidate approval; Claude independently hashes canonical approval bytes, Howard approves and types the public hash. Helpers do not grant approval.
preserved: Inline len(canonical(projection))+4096 proof before count send; fixed E2 role caps/holds.
Hidden in-process key prompt for LIVE only; ephemeral preview key and approval-identity exclusive use store.
Actual launch-time APFS ledger full-sync probe; runtime/code/manifest/pin joins; real fixed public-source no-spend rehearsal.
named_limits: Docker headroom is observed then bound to the fixed approval window, not reserved or continuously measured. Material storage change requires a new observation and new approval, never extension.
Read-only preflight cannot establish write/full-sync success; launch must qualify it before admission.
Synchronous full-sync may block; the existing attended stuck-step STOP applies. No send follows a blocked probe.
Hash integrity is not authentication. Generated approval.json is a review candidate only; independent review and Howard exact approval remain mandatory.
Python reference disposal is not guaranteed memory zeroization or protection against same-user/root inspection.
Rehearsal/CI is not native P5 qualification, hostile-code containment or power-loss proof.
prerequisites: No operator step, key entry or live action is authorized by this proposal. Exact review, CI and separate attended authorization still required.
